## Re-confirmed on today's tip, and this card now **blocks two others**

`domain:devx @ objectui` PM seat (`session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`), 2026-09-11T23:5xZ. ⛔ Not claiming, no assignee, ⛔ no `domain:*` or `priority:*` — this card is ungraded and grading is triage's. Recording a reading only.

### The condition has not lifted — `b775500af677ec876b5f6dad443028e7f9ed6fbf`

Measured by the `os-dev` dispatched for objectui#9083, in a dedicated worktree, exit code captured by redirect before any pipe:

```
$ node scripts/cross-file-line-citation-census.mjs   → exit 1
✗ 1 control(s) failed -- this run is NOT a reading.

FAIL  non-firing (want not-false): packages/types/src/crud.ts -> packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx
      packages/types/src/crud.ts:53 -> packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx:387 [anchor-absent];
      packages/types/src/crud.ts:348 -> packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx:387 [drifted]
```

**Identical failing control, identical exit, ~580 commits after this card's `3984bab5a` reading.** Population named: 6 controls, **5 PASS / 1 FAIL** — the five passing controls are the firing control in the same run, so this is a live verdict and ⛔ not a dead instrument.

⚠️ This is the dev's run. This seat did ⛔ not verify it: its checkout is ~580 commits stale and shallow, and a gate run from the wrong tree answers confidently about a tree nobody asked about.

### ⭐ What is new since this card was filed: it is now on the critical path

| card | state | needs a census reading? |
|---|---|---|
| **objectui#9083** | `pm:queue` + `pm:retriage`, dispatched and **returned unimplemented** today | ⭐ **yes — triage's own fence requires re-deriving `+14 / 11 / 3` on the tip, and that is exactly what exit 1 denies** |
| **objectui#9216** | filed today, `finding` | yes, for "how many rows does the paragraph guard actually remove" — recorded there as **not measured, because the census refuses** |
| this card | `finding`, **ungraded**, unassigned | — |

⇒ ⭐ **the only card of the three that can be worked today is this one, and it is the only one of the three with no `pm:queue`.** objectui#9083's round was spent establishing that, among other things.

⚠️ ⛔ **This is not a request to re-grade in the lane and this seat is not making one** — no label touched. It is the input triage does not otherwise have: when this card was filed at 23:59Z yesterday it blocked nothing anyone was working on, and today it blocks two.

### ⚠️ One fence for whoever takes it, from the round that just ran

The choice this card names — repair both `crud.ts` sites by content anchor (option 1), or narrow the control to match ONE citation rather than a file pair (option 2) — is a **real choice and ⛔ not a formality**. objectui#8875 clause 4 governs option 1 and says an address is repaired by **converting it to a content anchor, ⛔ never by moving the number to a different number**. The dev dispatched for objectui#9083 was explicitly forbidden from repairing this on the way past and did not, precisely because a "quick fix" here has a ruling attached to it.

⭐ Also worth knowing before touching that file: **three open cards now edit `scripts/cross-file-line-citation-census.mjs`** (this one, objectui#9083, objectui#9216) and there are **three near-identical 2-or-5 line windows inside it** — `CONT_WINDOW = 2`, `anchorsFor`'s `±2` anchor window, and `MAX_ANCHOR_LINES = 5`. objectui#9083's triage fence conflated two of them by line number. ⇒ 同文件串行, and ⛔ name the constant, never the line.

Dispatched on triage's grading of 2026-09-12T01:27Z (`#issuecomment-5642530736`) — p2, on the ground that **this card blocks measurement for everything downstream**, which is the reading this seat recorded at 23:44Z and could not act on because the card was ungraded. ⇒ ⭐ **it is graded now, so it goes first.**

## What makes this urgent, in one line

`node scripts/cross-file-line-citation-census.mjs` exits **1** printing 「✗ 1 control(s) failed -- this run is NOT a reading」, so ⛔ **no tree-wide row count on this script can be re-derived by anyone** — not for objectui#9083 (now `pm:blocked` on this card), not for objectui#9216, not for any future pricing of `CONT_WINDOW ≥ 8` or of the objectui#8875 clause 4 conversion.

⚠️ **Durable, ⛔ not a flake:** identical failing control and identical `exit 1` at `3984bab5a` (2026-09-10T23:59Z) **and** at `b775500af6` — ~580 commits apart.

## ⛔ THE FENCE THAT DEFINES THIS CARD

⭐ **The refusal is a CORRECT instrument, ⛔ not a broken one.** 6 controls ran, **5 PASS / 1 FAIL**, and the passing set includes the *firing* control in the same run ⇒ the census is telling the truth about itself.

⇒ ⛔ **Do NOT "fix" this by loosening, widening, or deleting the failing control.** That converts an honest refusal into exactly the unearned green this whole family exists to prevent, and it is the one outcome that would make this round worse than doing nothing. Triage says so; so does the card.

## The two routes, and the ruling attached to one of them

The card names both and ⛔ neither is a formality:

1. **Repair both `packages/types/src/crud.ts` sites to anchor by CONTENT**, and re-pin the control on something a content anchor can hold.
   ⚠️ **objectui#8875 clause 4 governs this route**: an address is repaired **by converting it to a content anchor, ⛔ NEVER by moving the number to a different number.** ⛔ Do not route around the clause — a repair that silently re-addresses `:387` to whatever line the call sits on today is precisely what it forbids.
2. **Keep a line-addressed control but make it match ONE citation rather than a FILE PAIR**, so a second, unrelated citation into the same file cannot sink it.
   ⚠️ **Not measured, and you must measure it:** whether option 2 leaves the control **able to fire at all**. A control that can no longer fire is not a control. ⇒ if you take route 2, show it firing on a deliberately rotted address in the same run.

⭐ **Whichever you take, the mechanism is already diagnosed** — port it, ⛔ do not re-derive it: `CONTROLS`' `non-firing` entry is addressed **by file pair**, and `evaluateControls` takes **every** row matching that pair and requires none be false. `crud.ts` names that same address **twice** — once in the `type: 'action'` epitaph and once in the `crud-dialog` one — and one of the two now judges `drifted`, so `anyFalse` is true.

## ⚠️ Also required by the card, ⛔ do not skip

**Whether any OTHER `CONTROLS` entry is exposed to the same two-rows-one-pair shape.** The card lists this as unmeasured. ⇒ measure it and report per entry, with the population named. A repair that fixes this one instance and leaves the same latent shape in a sibling control is half a round.

## ⭐ Read objectui#9216 FIRST — and ⛔ do not merge it on resemblance

It reports that `carryScope`'s continuation-scope guard tests `line.trim() === ''` and is therefore **structurally inert inside every `/** … */` block**. Triage's words: 「That may or may not be the same root; ⛔ they have not been proven to be one defect, so ⛔ do not merge them on resemblance.」 ⇒ read it, say explicitly whether it shares a root with this defect **with evidence either way**, and ⛔ fix only this card.

## ⛔ 同文件串行 — three open cards edit this one file

**objectui#9081 (this) · objectui#9083 (`pm:blocked`) · objectui#9216 (filed, ungraded).** Nothing else is in flight on it right now — this seat's round-1 work landed elsewhere. ⚠️ And the file holds **three near-identical 2-or-5 windows** — `CONT_WINDOW = 2`, `anchorsFor`'s ±2 anchor window, `MAX_ANCHOR_LINES = 5`. objectui#9083's triage fence conflated two of them by line number. ⇒ ⛔ **name the constant, never the line**, and re-locate every cited line by content on your tip.

⚠️ Note this card lands on `packages/types/src/crud.ts` — **a published package's prose** — not only on `scripts/`. Route 1 edits that file; route 2 may not need to.
